title: Notify the EPA of contaminated land
what: Notify the EPA as soon as practicable of notifiable contamination of land the business manages or controls.

sources.title: Environment Protection Act 2017 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: s 40(1) (authorised version 023, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: A person in management or control of land must notify the Authority if the land has been contaminated by notifiable contamination as soon as practicable after the person becomes aware of, or reasonably should have become aware of, the notifiable contamination

reach.condition: if it manages or controls land contaminated by notifiable contamination
